inspiration.observed_pattern: NVL2 maps a nullable expression to one result when non-NULL and another result when NULL.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored ticket pair so both nullable branches remain observable without copying source data or schema.

fixture_notes: One unresolved and one resolved ticket exercise both NVL2 branches.
determinism_notes: All ticket IDs, subjects, timestamps, NVL2 branches, and output ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE ticket_status (ticket_id INT PRIMARY KEY, subject VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, resolved_at DATETIME NULL)
INSERT INTO ticket_status VALUES (201, 'quota alert', NULL), (202, 'login timeout', '2026-02-04 11:20:00')

steps.sql: SELECT ticket_id, NVL2(resolved_at, 'RESOLVED', 'PENDING') AS lifecycle_label FROM ticket_status ORDER BY ticket_id
